subject: MAP Playbook: milestones & signature runway — Mosaic pre-proc alignment
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morris <elena@mosaichealth.com>, Mosaic Health Procurement <procurement@mosaichealth.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, Feb 24 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: MAP Playbook: milestones & signature runway — Mosaic pre-proc alignment

Hi Elena / Mosaic procurement team,

Thanks again for the time today — good discussion about integration surface area and compliance readouts. Attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP-draft-v1.xlsx) and a lightweight SOW outline for visibility. I captured the milestones we talked through and proposed owners; please treat this as a working doc.

High-level proposal:
- Target close date: 2026-04-30 (commercial go-live target: early May)
- Procurement / contract signature deadline: 2026-04-15 (we recommend signing 2 weeks prior to close to allow onboarding)
- Key off-ramps/dependencies: security questionnaire completion, legal SOW redlines, PCI/HIPAA scoping call (if required)

Suggested milestone owners (draft):
- Mosaic: procurement sign-off, contract execution (Elena + procurement team)
- Mosaic IT: security questionnaire & scoping (TBD)
- Redwood: SOW finalization, implementation schedule, onboarding plan (Sean / Markus)
- Redwood Security: SOC2 evidence & controls mapping (Hannah)

Immediate asks:
1) Can you confirm whether 4/15 for signature is feasible given your internal approval calendar?
2) Please share the name and contact for the person who will own the security questionnaire so we can route technical questions quickly.
3) If procurement prefers a different cadence for milestone reviews, we can adapt the MAP — just want to lock the signature runway.

Next steps: I'll incorporate any changes you send and circulate MAP v1.1 by EOD Thursday. If it helps, we can get legal on a brief call next week to accelerate SOW alignment.

Attachments: MAP-draft-v1.xlsx, SOW-outline.docx

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sean@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198

From: Elena Morris <elena@mosaichealth.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
Cc: Mosaic Health Procurement <procurement@mosaichealth.com>
Date: Wed, Feb 25 2026 10:36:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP Playbook: milestones & signature runway — Mosaic pre-proc alignment

Thanks Sean — appreciate the clear summary and the draft MAP. Quick notes from procurement:

- We like the structure. Our internal approval window is tied to a Board packet that goes in the week of April 20. That means the earliest fully executed contract we can commit to is around April 22, 2026. If legal can turn around redlines quickly we might shave a day or two, but April 22 is realistic for sign-off.
- Procurement prefers DocuSign for execution. We will need a version of the contract in redline-ready format by April 8 to meet internal review cycles.
- I'll route the security questionnaire to our IT security lead, Carlos Reyes (carlos.reyes@mosaichealth.com). He should expect Hannah's outreach; please include the needed evidence list in the questionnaire cover.

I've attached our procurement checklist (mosaic-procurement-checklist.pdf) for your reference — it lists the standard items our legal and finance teams expect. Two asks on our side: can you confirm SOW limits of liability and data residency statements in v1.1; and can you flag any pass/fail items in the security questionnaire up front?

If you want to align calendars, I'm available Thurs 2/26 10–11am PT for a 30-min working session.

Best,
Elena
Head of Strategic Partnerships, Mosaic Health
elena@mosaichealth.com

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, Feb 26 2026 08:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP Playbook: milestones & signature runway — Mosaic pre-proc alignment

Looping in to propose an internal plan to hit the revised runway (Elena called out Apr 22 as realistic). Quick take and action items:

- Move target signature to 2026-04-22 (per procurement). Keep commercial close = 2026-04-30.
- Compress the security questionnaire timeline: aim to have initial questionnaire + evidence mapping to Mosaic by 2026-03-12 so Carlos has ~6 weeks to complete internal validation. Hannah: can your team prioritize the controls mapping and evidence zip by 3/12?
- Legal: I'll ping Legal Prod Counsel for a 2-week turnaround on SOW redlines. Sean: please mark \"SOW-outline.docx\" as high priority and add a quick summary of liability/residency asks in the file header so legal can triage.
- Contingency: if any pass/fail item arises in security review, propose a short-term mitigation (contractual commitments + phased onboarding) to avoid pushing the signature date. We should predefine a \"phase 0\" scope that can ship without full scope compliance.

I'll prepare an updated MAP (v1.1) reflecting the April 22 sign date and the accelerated questionnaire milestone. Sean: want to send the working session invite for Thursday 2/26 10am PT to Elena? I'll include Legal and Security as optional attendees.

-Markus
Director, Enterprise Sales Engineering
markus_klein@redwood.com

From: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morris <elena@mosaichealth.com>, Mosaic Health Procurement <procurement@mosaichealth.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, Feb 27 2026 16:03:00 -0800
Subject: RE: MAP Playbook: milestones & signature runway — Mosaic pre-proc alignment

Thanks Elena — appreciate the procurement timeline context and routing to Carlos. Per Markus' note we've updated the plan to align to a 2026-04-22 signature runway and preserved 2026-04-30 as the commercial close target. Attached is MAP-draft-v1.1.xlsx (incorporates Apr 22 sign date, ownership table, and compressed security milestone).

Key updates in v1.1:
- Procurement signature: 2026-04-22 (owner: Mosaic procurement)
- Security questionnaire initial package to Mosaic: 2026-03-12 (owner: Redwood Security — Hannah)
- SOW redline deadline for Mosaic review: 2026-04-08 (owner: Redwood Legal / Sean)
- Phase 0 fallback scope documented (minimal onboarding to unblock initial usage if any high-risk controls need time)

Action items for Mosaic:
- Confirm Carlos (carlos.reyes@mosaichealth.com) as security lead and any additional evidence expectations.
- Confirm that DocuSign is acceptable and whether procurement requires a specific account/email for signing.
- Review MAP v1.1 and confirm or suggest edits by EOD Tue 3/2 so we can lock Milestone owners and publish to HubSpot.

DocuSign link (placeholder): https://docusign.example.com/rooms/DEAL-1729
HubSpot: https://hubspot.example.com/deals/DEAL-1729
Drive: https://drive.example.com/drive/folders/1A2B3C-MAP-v1

Attachments: MAP-draft-v1.1.xlsx, SOW-outline.docx

On the working session — Elena, sending calendar now for Thurs 2/26 10–10:30am PT. If that doesn't work we can move to the early next week.

Thanks and looking forward to locking this down,
Sean
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sean@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198
